ops.title: claude agents --json listing rule (Claude Code 2.1.323), reimplemented in drive agents.gone
ops.body: Read from the 2.1.323 binary by codex (reply /Users/yasyf/.cache/codex-ask/runs/codex-ask.3550542979/codex-r-2005788999). Inputs: <config>/sessions/<digits>.json (pid from file name; live when pid>1, kill(pid,0) ok, and procStartFt??procStart absent or equal to 'ps -o lstart= -p pid' under LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC, or ps lists nothing), <config>/jobs/<id>/state.json (row id = folder name), and the daemon's control-socket list, falling back to <config>/daemon/roster.json (proto 1, workers by 8-hex id, same liveness). A job unfinished, absent from the live set and older than 5 s is re-marked blocked (raw blocked) or failed; default listing keeps working/blocked or any job with a live session. Only spawn is ps. PR yasyf/cc-skills#4703 (long-running 1.0.567) moved agents.gone/end_handler onto these files and the drive's Jev calls in-process onto spawnllm.decide_sync in a uv venv at <state>/venv.
